module traffic_light (
    input clk, reset,
    output [2:0] light
);

    wire w1, w2, w3, w4, w5, w6, w7, w8, w9, w10, w11;

    assign w1 = clk & reset; // AND gate top left
    assign w2 = reset; // reset passed through to first D flip-flop input
    assign w2 = reg2_ff_pipeline_ff1; // DFF output w2
    assign w3 = ~clk; // NOT gate middle left
    assign w4 = clk & w2; // AND gate middle
    assign w5 = ~clk; // NOT gate from w3
    assign w6 = w4 & w1; // AND gate above second DFF
    assign w7 = reset; // reset passed through to another D flip-flop input
    assign w8 = ~clk; // NOT gate from w3
    assign w9 = (~v2)) | (v1 & ~v0); // MUX logic (assuming v1,v0 are reset,clk)
    assign w10 = w5; // w5 passed through to third DFF input
    assign w11 = (~clk); // additional NOT gate

    // D Flip-Flop instances
    DFF #(.INIT(1'b0)) inst1 (
        .clock(clock),
        .d(w2),
        .q(reg2_ff_pipeline_ff1),
        .presetn(1'b1),
        .clearn(1'b1),
        .sync_enable(1'b0),
        .sync_set(1'b0),
        .rc(n),
        .le(1'b0)
    );

    // Additional DFF for the second path
    DFF #(.INIT(1'b0)) inst2 (
        .clock(clock),
        .d(w7),
        .q(reg2_ff_pipeline_ff2),
        .presetn(1'b1),
        .clearn(1'b1),
        .sync_enable(1'b0),
        .sync_set(1'b0),
        .rc(n),
        .le(1'b0)
    );

    // Third DFF for the third path
    DFF #(.INIT(1'b0)) inst3 (
        .clock(clock),
        .d(w10),
        .q(reg2_ff_pipeline_ff3),
        .presetn(1'b1),
        .clearn(1'b1),
        .sync_enable(1'b0),
        .sync_set(1'b0),
        .rc(n),
        .le(1'b0)
    );

    // MUX for w9
    // assign w9 = w4; // Assuming reset is w1, clk is w3

    // NAND gates for output logic
    assign w10 = w6 | w9; // NAND gate top right
    assign w11 = w6 & w9; // NAND gate middle right
    assign w12 = w6 | w10; // NAND gate bottom right
    assign w13 = w6 & w11; // NAND gate below middle right

    assign light[2] = w10;
    assign light[1] = w11;
    assign light[0] = w12;

endmodule

module rotate_left (
    input [7:0] in,
    input [2:0] shift,
    output [7:0] out
);

assign out =
    (!in[7] & in[6]) |
    (!in[6] & in[5]) |
    (!in[5] & in[4]) |
    (!in[4] & in[3]) |
    (!in[3] & in[2]) |
    (!in[2] & in[1]) |
    (!in[1] & in[0]) |
    (!in[0] & in[1]);

generate
    genvar i;
    for (i = 0; i < 3; i = i + 1) begin : gen_block_1
        assign out[i] = (in[i] & !shift[i]) |
                          (!in[i] & shift[i]);
    end
endgenerate

generate
    genvar j;
    for (j = 0; j < 3; j = j + 1) begin : gen_block_2
        assign out[3 + j] = (in[3 + j] & !shift[j]) |
                              (!in[3 + j] & shift[j]);
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

    input clk,
    input rst,
    input load,
    input [7:0] pin,
    output sout
);

    reg sout;

    always @(*) begin
        // Decode pin based on its 8 bits
        case (pin)
            1'b0: begin
                if (clk && !(rst)) begin
                    sout = 1;
                end else if (rst) begin
                    sout = 0;
                end else begin
                    sout = 1;
                end
            end
            1'b1: begin

          (clk & reset & w) |
          (~clk & reset & ~w) |
          (~clk & ~reset & w) |
          (~clk & ~reset & ~w);
  
  z = ~(z & (clk | reset));
end

endmodule

module comparator_4bit(
    input [3:0] A,   // First 4-bit input operand
    input [3:0] B,   // Second 4-bit input operand
    output A_greater, 
    output A_equal,   
    output A_less     
);

    // Internal wires for all gate outputs
    wire out_0, out_1, out_2, out_3, out_4, out_5, out_6, out_7, out_8, out_9, out_10,
         out_11, out_12, out_13, out_14, out_15, out_16, out_17, out_18, out_19, out_20,
         out_21, out_22, out_23, out_24, out_25, out_26, out_27, out_28, out_29, out_30,
         out_31, out_32, out_33, out_34, out_35, out_36, out_37;

    // Define gates according to the circuit diagram
    // First block at top
    assign out_0 = ~(&{B[3], B[2]}); // NAND of B[3:2]
    assign out_1 = |{A[3], A[2]}; // OR of A[3:2]
    assign out_2 = ~&{A[3], A[2], B[3], B[2]}; // NAND of 4 bits
    assign out_3 = ||{B[3], B[2], A[3], A[2], B[3], B[2]}; // OR of 6 bits (redundant, simplifies to OR of B[3:2] and A[3:2])
    assign out_4 = &{(!B[3]), (!B[2]), (!A[3]), (!A[2])}; // NOR of B[3:2] and A[3:2]
    assign out_5 = (B[3] == A[3]) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Equality check for bit 3
    assign out_6 = (B[2] == A[2]) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Equality check for bit 2
    assign out_7 = (B[1] == A[1]) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Equality check for bit 1
    assign out_8 = (B[0] == A[0]) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Equality check for bit 0

    // Second block
    assign out_9 = ~|{out_0, out_1}; // NOR of out_0 and out_1
    assign out_10 = ~&{out_2, out_3}; // NAND of out_2 and out_3
    assign out_11 = ~|{out_4, out_5, out_6}; // NOR of out_4, out_5, out_6
    assign out_12 = ~&{out_7, out_8}; // NAND of out_7 and out_8
    assign out_13 = ~|{out_9, out_10}; // NOR of out_9 and out_10
    assign out_14 = ~&{out_11, out_12}; // NAND of out_11 and out_12
    assign out_15 = ~|{out_13, out_14}; // NOR of out_13 and out_14

    // Third block
    assign out_16 = ~|{out_5, out_6, out_7, out_8}; // NOR of out_5 to out_8
    assign out_17 = ~&{out_0, out_1, out_2, out_3}; // NAND of out_0 to out_3
    assign out_18 = ~|{out_4, out_5, out_6, out_7, out_8}; // NOR of out_4 to out_8
    assign out_19 = ~&{out_9, out_10, out_11, out_12, out_13, out_14, out_15}; // NAND of out_9 to out_15
    assign out_20 = ~|{out_16, out_17, out_18, out_19}; // NOR of out_16 to out_19
    assign out_21 = ~&{out_1, out_2, out_3, out_5, out_6}; // NAND of out_1 to out_6
    assign out_22 = ~|{out_4, out_7}; // NOR of out_4 and out_7
    assign out_23 = ~&{out_11, out_12, out_14}; // NAND of out_11, out_12, out_14
    assign out_24 = ~|{out_0, out_1, out_3}; // NOR of out_0, out_1, out_3
    assign out_25 = ~&{out_5, out_6, out_7, out_8}; // NAND of out_5 to out_8
    assign out_26 = ~|{out_9, out_10, out_13}; // NOR of out_9, out_10, out_13
    assign out_27 = ~&{out_11, out_12, out_14}; // NAND of out_11, out_12, out_14 (duplicate)
    assign out_28 = ~|{out_16, out_17, out_18}; // NOR of out_16 to out_18
    assign out_29 = ~&{out_1, out_2, out_3, out_5, out_6, out_7, out_8}; // NAND of out_1 to out_8
    assign out_30 = ~|{out_4, out_5}; // NOR of out_4 and out_5
    assign out_31 = ~&{out_9, out_10, out_13, out_14}; // NAND of out_9 to out_14
    assign out_32 = ~|{out_2, out_3, out_5}; // NOR of out_2 to out_5
    assign out_33 = ~&{out_0, out_1, out_2, out_3, out_4, out_5, out_6, out_7, out_8}; // NAND of out_0 to out_8
    assign out_34 = ~|{out_9, out_10, out_11}; // NOR of out_9 to out_11
    assign out_35 = ~&{out_1, out_2, out_3, out_5, out_6, out_7, out_8}; // NAND of out_1 to out_8 (duplicate)
    assign out_36 = ~|{out_4, out_7, out_8}; // NOR of out_4, out_7, out_8
    assign out_37 = ~&{out_9, out_10, out_13, out_14, out_15, out_16}; // NAND of out_9 to out_16

    // Final assignments for outputs
    assign A_greater = out_15; // From the last gate in the top-right chain
    assign A_equal = out_20; // From the last gate in the middle-right chain
    assign A_less = out_29; // From the last gate in the bottom-right chain

endmodule

module counter_12(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset_n) begin
  if (reset_n) begin
    out <= 4'b0000;
  end
  else begin
    case (out)
      3'b0: out <= 4'b{clk, rst_n, clk, valid_count};
      3'b0: out <= 4'b{clk, rst_n, clk, valid_count};
    endcase
  end
end

endmodule
